subtitle.zh: 和妈妈、妹妹，在冬天找一点暖和
subtitle.en: Finding a little winter warmth with Mum and my sister

intro.zh: 十二月，我和妈妈、妹妹去了三亚。想法很简单：冬天去一个暖和的地方，陪她们放松。翻回这些照片，最先记起来的不是排了多少行程，而是三个人站到海边、轮流拍照，再一起走进水里的那些小片段。
intro.en: In December, I went to Sanya with Mum and my younger sister. The idea was simple: find somewhere warm in winter and spend some relaxed time with them. Looking back through these photos, what comes to mind first is not how much we fitted into the itinerary, but the little moments of standing together by the sea, taking turns for pictures, and then getting into the water together.

title.en: From the cabin to the hotel

paragraphs.zh: 出发时，我们先在飞机上挤进了同一个镜头。妈妈还穿着红色外套，三个人的合照里，还能看出冬天的样子。
paragraphs.en: Before we set off, we squeezed into the same frame on the plane. Mum was still wearing her red jacket; there was still a little winter in that picture of the three of us.

caption.zh: 我、妈妈和妹妹，先在飞机上留下一张合照。
caption.en: Mum, my sister and me, together before the trip began.

paragraphs.zh: 晚上到了酒店，圣诞树已经摆好，树下堆着装饰礼盒。十二月没有消失，只是换了一个背景。进到房间，放下赶路的节奏，这段和家人一起的假期才真正有了落点。
paragraphs.en: At the hotel that evening, the Christmas tree was already up, with decorative presents underneath. December had not disappeared; it had simply changed its backdrop. Once we were in the room and the journey had slowed down, our family break finally had somewhere to settle.

caption.zh: 十二月的第一晚，酒店里已经有了圣诞的样子。
caption.en: The hotel was already dressed for Christmas on our first December night.

caption.zh: 抵达之后，旅行终于从赶路变成了安顿下来。
caption.en: After travelling, it was time to settle in.

paragraphs.zh: 房间里还有蓝色的画和桌灯，沙发旁挂着另一盏灯。晚上拍下这些小角落，也把我们住过的房间一起留在了这段旅程里。
paragraphs.en: There was a blue picture and a desk lamp in the room, and another lamp hanging beside the sofa. Taking pictures of these little corners that evening meant the room we stayed in became part of the trip too.

caption.zh: 房间里的蓝色画和桌灯，也留在了抵达这一晚。
caption.en: The blue picture and desk lamp, part of our first evening in the room.

caption.zh: 沙发旁的一盏吊灯，把这个小角落照亮了。
caption.en: A hanging lamp lighting a small corner beside the sofa.

paragraphs.zh: 早晨从酒店望出去，远山还在云下面。
paragraphs.en: Looking out from the hotel in the morning, the distant hills were still under cloud.

caption.zh: 早晨从酒店望出去，远山还罩在云下面。
caption.en: The hills beyond the hotel were still under cloud that morning.

paragraphs.zh: 水景和椰树挨在一起，客房楼的阳台一层层向上排开。昨晚拍的是房间里的角落，早晨就把镜头转到了树和楼。
paragraphs.en: Water and coconut palms stood side by side, with rows of balconies rising above them. Last night I had photographed the corners of our room; this morning the camera turned towards trees and buildings.

caption.zh: 水景和椰树，把酒店的早晨变成了绿绿的一片。
caption.en: Water and coconut palms bringing a little green to the hotel morning.

caption.zh: 客房楼的阳台，一层层排在椰树上方。
caption.en: Rows of balconies rising above the coconut palms.

paragraphs.zh: 再走到草坪边，周围还是一圈椰子树。这一天，先从酒店和海边看起。
paragraphs.en: Then we reached the lawn, still surrounded by coconut palms. This day began with the hotel and the sea.

caption.zh: 花园里的台阶，把楼和草坪接到了一起。
caption.en: Garden steps connecting the buildings and the lawn.

caption.zh: 从楼里出来，眼前变成了草坪和椰子树。
caption.en: Outside, the view gave way to lawns and coconut palms.

paragraphs.zh: 妈妈换了绿色花裙，妹妹穿着白上衣和粉色裙子，两个人站在浅浅的浪边。我把镜头对过去，先各拍一张。
paragraphs.en: Mum had changed into a green floral dress, while my sister wore a white top and a pink skirt. They stood beside the shallow waves, and I pointed the camera towards them for a picture of each.

caption.zh: 妈妈换上了绿色花裙，站到浪边。
caption.en: Mum in her green floral dress at the water's edge.

caption.zh: 妹妹的白上衣和粉裙子，也进入了同一片海景。
caption.en: My sister's white top and pink skirt against the same stretch of sea.

paragraphs.zh: 然后是三个人一起站到海边。风景照里只有海，合照里才有这次出门的人。
paragraphs.en: Then the three of us stood together by the sea. A landscape photograph has the sea in it; a family picture has the people who came on this trip.

caption.zh: 三个人站在一起，比单独的风景更像这次旅行。
caption.en: The three of us together: the picture that makes this our trip.

paragraphs.zh: 这一上午的照片里，我们换了不少姿势。妈妈和妹妹都张开过手臂，像是终于可以把身体从冬天的衣服里伸展开来。
paragraphs.en: We tried quite a few poses that morning. Mum and my sister both spread their arms, as though they could finally stretch out of their winter clothes.

caption.zh: 妈妈张开手臂，背景已经有了蓝天。
caption.en: Mum spreading her arms beneath a patch of blue sky.

caption.zh: 妹妹也在沙滩上留下一张张开手臂的照片。
caption.en: My sister spreading her arms on the sand too.

paragraphs.zh: 镜头再转向没有人的方向：沙滩弯过去，浪沿着岸边铺开，远处是低低的山。亚龙湾的这一小段海岸，先替这趟旅行定下了慢一点的节奏。
paragraphs.en: I turned the camera towards a view without anyone in it: the beach curving away, waves spreading along the shore, and low hills in the distance. This little stretch of Yalong Bay set a slower pace for the trip.

caption.zh: 亚龙湾的弧线，把这段冬日假期轻轻圈了起来。
caption.en: The curve of Yalong Bay framing our winter break.

paragraphs.zh: 再把镜头举近一点，妈妈、妹妹和我靠在一起留下一张自拍。接着是我和妹妹的合照，身后的蓝天和椰树没变，头发倒都被吹得有些乱。比起远远站好的照片，这两张把那一上午的轻松留得更近。
paragraphs.en: Bringing the camera a little closer, Mum, my sister and I leaned together for a selfie. Then came a picture of my sister and me. The blue sky and palms behind us were the same, though our hair had been blown about. Compared with the pictures where we stood farther away, these two kept that relaxed morning a little closer.

caption.zh: 把镜头举近一点，妈妈、妹妹和我又靠到了一起。
caption.en: A closer picture of Mum, my sister and me together.

caption.zh: 我和妹妹再合一张影，身后还是同一片蓝天。
caption.en: One more picture with my sister, beneath the same blue sky.

paragraphs.zh: 回到酒店的草坪，椰树后面露出一座尖顶建筑。背景换了，轮流拍照的顺序没怎么变。
paragraphs.en: Back on the hotel lawn, a pointed roof appeared behind the palms. The backdrop changed, but taking turns for pictures stayed much the same.

caption.zh: 从沙滩回到草坪，椰树后面露出尖尖的屋顶。
caption.en: Back from the beach, a pointed roof appeared beyond the palms.

paragraphs.zh: 妈妈先站过去，妹妹再站到差不多的位置。这样的照片不需要特别的安排，就是一起走到哪里，便在那里留下一点记忆。
paragraphs.en: Mum went first, then my sister stood in almost the same spot. Pictures like these do not need much arranging: wherever we walked together, we left a little memory.

caption.zh: 妈妈的草坪留影，还是那条绿色花裙。
caption.en: Mum on the lawn, still in her green floral dress.

caption.zh: 妹妹站到同一个背景前，留下一张自己的照片。
caption.en: My sister taking her turn in front of the same backdrop.

paragraphs.zh: 最后，她们站在一起举起手。比起反复调整一个姿势，这张共同做动作的照片更像我们这次来放松的样子。
paragraphs.en: Finally, they stood together and raised their arms. Rather than endlessly adjusting a pose, this shared gesture looked more like the relaxed break we had come for.

caption.zh: 两个人一起举起手，拍照也成了放松的一部分。
caption.en: Arms up together: taking pictures became part of slowing down.

paragraphs.zh: 下午的背景换成了亚龙湾的森林公园。到了过江龙索桥，妈妈先在指示牌旁比了一个手势。
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon, the backdrop changed to the forest park above Yalong Bay. At the Guojianglong suspension bridge, Mum first posed beside the sign.

caption.zh: 妈妈在过江龙索桥的指示牌旁比了一个手势。
caption.en: Mum posing beside the Guojianglong suspension-bridge sign.

paragraphs.zh: 走到桥上，妈妈扶着桥边的绳网，身后的海湾已经离得远了一点。她和妹妹再靠到一起，桥也成了合影的背景。
paragraphs.en: On the bridge, Mum held the rope netting, with the bay a little farther behind her now. She and my sister leaned together again, and the bridge became another backdrop for their picture.

caption.zh: 妈妈扶着桥边的绳网，身后是山和海。
caption.en: Mum beside the bridge ropes, with hills and sea behind her.

caption.zh: 妈妈和妹妹在桥上靠在一起。
caption.en: Mum and my sister together on the bridge.

paragraphs.zh: 从高处往外看，海湾、房子和树林挨在一起。早上站在岸边看海，下午再从山上看，才发现同一片地方可以有两种尺度。当然，三个人也没有忘记在这里再拍一张自拍。
paragraphs.en: From above, the bay, buildings and trees lay together in one view. Seeing the sea from the shore in the morning and from the hill in the afternoon showed the same place at two different scales. Of course, the three of us took another selfie here too.

caption.zh: 从山上看，海湾、房子和树林连成了另一幅画面。
caption.en: From the hill, the bay, buildings and forest formed a different view.

caption.zh: 换了地方，三个人的合照继续。
caption.en: A new backdrop for another picture of the three of us.

paragraphs.zh: 沿着园里的路走，妈妈和石鸡合了影，妹妹在“北纬18”的牌子旁举起一只手。旅行里这些小停顿，反而把相册填得很具体。
paragraphs.en: Along the park paths, Mum posed beside a stone rooster, while my sister raised a hand by the '18° North' sign. These little pauses gave the album its particular details.

caption.zh: 妈妈和园里的石鸡合了一张影。
caption.en: Mum posing beside a stone rooster in the park.

caption.zh: 妹妹在“北纬18”的牌子旁举起一只手。
caption.en: My sister raising a hand by the '18° North' sign.

paragraphs.zh: 再把镜头转向山里，绿色就一层层延伸到远处。那一段照片里，海暂时退到了后面。
paragraphs.en: Turning the camera inland, the greenery stretched away in layers. For this part of the album, the sea receded into the background.

caption.zh: 镜头转向山里，绿色一直铺到远处。
caption.en: Turning inland, the greenery stretched into the distance.

paragraphs.zh: 步道边有悬挂的小牌子，也有粉色的花。往下走的时候，台阶又进入树影。一路不只是抬头看远处，也会低头看见这些小东西。
paragraphs.en: Small tokens hung beside the path, and there were pink flowers too. Walking down, the steps led back into the shade of the trees. We did not only look up at distant views; there were little things to notice nearby as well.

caption.zh: 林间挂着一层层小牌子。
caption.en: Rows of small hanging tokens along the wooded path.

caption.zh: 路边的一簇粉花，也留在了相册里。
caption.en: A cluster of pink flowers found its way into the album.

caption.zh: 往下走，台阶又钻进了树影里。
caption.en: The steps led back into the shade of the trees.

paragraphs.zh: 相册里还留着树影下的石阶，以及围栏后的一只鸵鸟。除了看远处的海湾，山里的这些小场景也值得记下来。
paragraphs.en: The album also kept a stone stairway under the trees and an ostrich behind a railing. Alongside the distant bay, these small forest scenes were worth remembering too.

caption.zh: 林间石阶尽头，还有一片被树遮住的水面。
caption.en: Water beyond the shaded steps, partly hidden by the trees.

caption.zh: 园里的鸵鸟，也成了这段山林行程的一张记忆。
caption.en: An ostrich in the park, another small memory from the forest outing.

paragraphs.zh: 妈妈和妹妹轮流坐进花环里的椅子，又一起坐上秋千。今天已经拍了不少照片，但这几张还是留下来了：两个人用同一个背景，再一起进入同一张画面。
paragraphs.en: Mum and my sister took turns in the chair inside a floral circle, then sat together on a swing. We had already taken plenty of pictures that day, but I kept these: two people sharing the same backdrop, then entering the same frame.

caption.zh: 妈妈先坐进了花环里的椅子。
caption.en: Mum taking a seat inside the floral circle.

caption.zh: 妹妹也坐到同一把椅子上。
caption.en: My sister trying the same seat.

caption.zh: 最后，两个人一起坐上了秋千。
caption.en: A shared seat on the swing before leaving the park.

paragraphs.zh: 晚上转进商场，圣诞装饰又亮了起来。这一天从酒店的草坪、海边的浪走到山里的树影，最后收在了商场灯光和一杯冰淇淋的照片里。
paragraphs.en: In the evening we went into a mall, where the Christmas decorations were lit again. A day that had moved from the hotel lawn and waves to the wooded hills ended in pictures of mall lights and a cup of ice cream.

caption.zh: 晚上，商场的圣诞装饰又亮了起来。
caption.en: Christmas decorations lighting up the mall that evening.

caption.zh: 这一晚的照片，最后落在了一杯冰淇淋上。
caption.en: That evening's pictures ended with a cup of ice cream.

title.en: Time for the sea and pool

paragraphs.zh: 这一天的海边照片，蓝天明显了很多。妈妈和妹妹换了浅色裙子，再走到浪边。没有换一个遥远的目的地，只是又回到了海边。
paragraphs.en: The sky was much bluer in this day's beach pictures. Mum and my sister changed into pale dresses and returned to the waves. We had not gone somewhere far away; we were simply back by the sea.

caption.zh: 第二个海边上午，妈妈把手臂伸向蓝天。
caption.en: Mum reaching towards the blue sky on our next morning by the sea.

caption.zh: 妹妹换了一条浅色裙子，转身望向海面。
caption.en: My sister in a pale dress, turning towards the sea.

paragraphs.zh: 妹妹提起裙摆，浪在脚边靠过来。
paragraphs.en: My sister lifted her skirt as a wave came towards her feet.

caption.zh: 妹妹轻轻提起裙摆，让浪靠过来。
caption.en: My sister lifting her skirt as the water came in.

paragraphs.zh: 妈妈也站进了浅水里，裙摆和浪花出现在同一张照片里。这一上午，不必做什么特别的事，就已经有了不少可以留下的画面。
paragraphs.en: Mum stepped into the shallows too, with her dress and the foam in the same picture. There was no need to do anything extraordinary that morning to have plenty worth keeping.

caption.zh: 妈妈站在浪里，裙摆和海水一起动。
caption.en: Mum at the water's edge, her dress moving with the waves.

paragraphs.zh: 两个人先面对镜头站在一起，再转身看海。我继续把她们拍进照片，让这一段不急着去别处的时间留得久一点。
paragraphs.en: They first stood together facing the camera, then turned towards the sea. I kept photographing them, holding on a little longer to this time without a rush to go elsewhere.

caption.zh: 妈妈和妹妹并肩站进了海里。
caption.en: Mum and my sister side by side in the shallows.

caption.zh: 转过身去，照片就只剩下她们和海。
caption.en: Turning away, with the sea ahead of them.

paragraphs.zh: 换好泳衣之后，就不只是站在岸边拍照了。妈妈和妹妹一起在浅水里玩，浪扑过来的时候，两个人还拉着手。
paragraphs.en: After changing into swimwear, they were no longer just posing beside the water. Mum and my sister played in the shallows together, still holding hands as the waves came in.

caption.zh: 换好泳衣，浪花这次真的扑到了身上。
caption.en: Back in swimwear, with the waves splashing around them.

caption.zh: 妈妈和妹妹在水里拉着手。
caption.en: Mum and my sister holding hands in the water.

paragraphs.zh: 下午回到酒店泳池。妈妈在喷泉旁，妹妹游到另一边，背景从海面换成了椰树和蓝色池水。
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon we were back at the hotel pool. Mum was by the water jets, while my sister swam to the other side. The sea had given way to coconut palms and blue pool water.

caption.zh: 下午到了泳池，妈妈在水边的喷泉旁。
caption.en: Mum by the pool's water jets that afternoon.

caption.zh: 妹妹游到另一边，身后又是椰林。
caption.en: My sister in the pool, with palms behind her.

paragraphs.zh: 她们又在泳池里靠在一起。海里和泳池里都是两个人的合影，背景在变，一起玩水的样子没有变。
paragraphs.en: They leaned together in the pool again. At the sea and at the pool, there were pictures of the same two people: the backdrop changed, but being in the water together stayed the same.

caption.zh: 两个人在泳池里靠在一起。
caption.en: Mum and my sister together in the pool.

paragraphs.zh: 再抬头拍一张椰子树。画面里有阳光、泳池和一片蓝天，很难把它和十二月联系起来。冬天来一个暖和地方的念头，在这里变得十分具体。
paragraphs.en: I looked up for one more picture of the palms. With sunshine, a pool and blue sky in the frame, it was hard to connect it with December. The idea of finding somewhere warm in winter had become quite tangible here.

caption.zh: 泳池外的椰子树，把冬天遮到了照片之外。
caption.en: Palms above the pool, with winter nowhere in the picture.

paragraphs.zh: 傍晚走到酒店的水景前，妈妈和妹妹又各留了一张。天空转成了带云的颜色，水里把远处的线条映了回来。
paragraphs.en: Later that afternoon, we went to the hotel's reflecting pool, where Mum and my sister each had another picture taken. The sky had become cloudier, and the water reflected the lines in the distance.

caption.zh: 傍晚，妈妈站在酒店的水景前。
caption.en: Mum beside the hotel's reflecting pool later that afternoon.

caption.zh: 妹妹也留下了同一个背景的照片。
caption.en: My sister with the same backdrop.

paragraphs.zh: 最后拍了一张没有人的倒影。不需要再往里面放什么，这一天到这里就够了。
paragraphs.en: Finally, I took a picture of the reflection without anyone in it. There was no need to add anything else; that was enough for the day.

caption.zh: 没有人的这一张，只留下天空在水里的倒影。
caption.en: An empty frame, with the sky reflected in the water.

title.zh: 南山的蓝天，机场的晚霞
title.en: Blue skies at Nanshan, sunset at the airport

paragraphs.zh: 早晨，妈妈坐上了写着“Sheraton Yalong Bay”的秋千。她换了一身浅色花上衣和白裤子，海仍然在背后。这张照片，也把我们住过的酒店留在了画面里。
paragraphs.en: In the morning, Mum sat on the swing marked 'Sheraton Yalong Bay'. She had changed into a pale floral top and white trousers, with the sea still behind her. This picture kept the hotel we had stayed in as part of the album too.

caption.zh: 最后一天早晨，妈妈坐在写着 Sheraton Yalong Bay 的秋千上。
caption.en: Mum on the 'Sheraton Yalong Bay' swing on our last morning.

paragraphs.zh: 之后去了南山。蓝天下先是石柱，再是步道尽头的海上观音。和前一天在泳池边的时间相比，今天的照片里多了台阶、石刻和高大的建筑。
paragraphs.en: After that, we went to Nanshan. First came stone columns beneath the blue sky, then the Guanyin statue beyond the walkway. Compared with yesterday's time at the pool, today's pictures had more steps, stonework and tall buildings.

caption.zh: 到了南山，先看见蓝天下的石柱。
caption.en: Stone columns beneath the blue sky as we reached Nanshan.

caption.zh: 再往前，海上观音出现在步道尽头。
caption.en: The Guanyin statue appearing beyond the walkway.

paragraphs.zh: 走近再抬头看，观音站在层层基座上，身后是一大片蓝天。
paragraphs.en: Closer up, Guanyin stood on layers of plinths, with a great expanse of blue sky behind.

caption.zh: 抬头看观音，蓝天成了很大的背景。
caption.en: Looking up at Guanyin against a wide expanse of blue sky.

paragraphs.zh: 妹妹撑起了伞，站在海边栏杆旁。蓝天很醒目，伞也成了这个下午的小细节。
paragraphs.en: My sister opened an umbrella beside the seafront railing. The blue sky stood out, and the umbrella became another little detail of the afternoon.

caption.zh: 妹妹撑起了伞，站在海边的栏杆旁。
caption.en: My sister under an umbrella beside the seafront railing.

paragraphs.zh: 沿着海岸看过去，远处有塔和山，近处的海面是一大片蓝色。相册里这些没有人的照片，替我们记下了那天身边的背景。
paragraphs.en: Looking along the coast, there were a tower and hills in the distance, and a broad stretch of blue water nearby. These photographs without people kept the backdrop of that day for us.

caption.zh: 沿海看过去，远处的塔和山靠在一起。
caption.en: A distant tower against the hillside along the coast.

caption.zh: 这一天的海，蓝得很直接。
caption.en: The sea was unmistakably blue that day.

paragraphs.zh: 从海边转回园里，又经过开阔的草坪。椰子树和山都还在，画面却安静了很多。
paragraphs.en: Turning from the sea back into the grounds, we passed an open lawn. The palms and hills were still there, but the picture felt much quieter.

caption.zh: 开阔的草坪上，远处的观音露在树冠上方。
caption.en: An open lawn, with Guanyin appearing above the treetops.

paragraphs.zh: 妈妈在石灯旁停下来拍照。一路上，她的花上衣和白裤子出现在不同的背景前，这一张就留在绿色草地里。
paragraphs.en: Mum stopped for a photograph beside a stone lantern. Her floral top and white trousers appeared against different backdrops along the way; this one stayed among the green grass.

caption.zh: 妈妈在石灯旁又停了一次。
caption.en: Mum stopping for a picture beside a stone lantern.

paragraphs.zh: 再往前是一片椰林，地上铺着树影，树与树之间摆着石雕。三亚的这些绿色，不只在海边。
paragraphs.en: Farther along was a grove of coconut palms, with shadows on the paving and stone sculptures between the trees. Sanya's greenery was not only by the beach.

caption.zh: 走到这一片椰林，树影把空地分成了明暗两边。
caption.en: Palm-tree shadows across an open space along our walk.

paragraphs.zh: 走到南山寺，拍下匾额和椰林之间的屋顶。
paragraphs.en: At Nanshan Temple, I photographed the sign and the roofs between the palms.

caption.zh: 南山寺的匾额，让这一段路有了名字。
caption.en: The Nanshan Temple sign marking this part of our walk.

caption.zh: 椰树之间，露出院落的屋顶。
caption.en: Temple roofs between the coconut palms.

paragraphs.zh: 再从寺院附近望向海，前面是伸向海面的岩石，远处的观音从树冠上方露出来。比起之前走近看的那一张，这里的天和海占了更大的一片。
paragraphs.en: Looking towards the sea from near the temple, rocks stretched out in front of us, and the distant Guanyin appeared above the treetops. Compared with the earlier close view, there was much more sky and sea in this frame.

caption.zh: 观音退到树冠后面，眼前留下了一大片天和海。
caption.en: Guanyin beyond the treetops, with sky and sea opening out ahead.

paragraphs.zh: 再走到写着“海天丛林”的墙前，拍下殿前的屋檐和白色台阶，回头还能看见远处的海上观音。从很近到很远，这些照片把这一段路的转向也留下了。
paragraphs.en: At the wall bearing the words 'Haitian Conglin', I photographed the temple eaves and white steps, then looked back towards Guanyin in the distance. From close to far away, these pictures kept the changes of direction along this part of our walk.

caption.zh: 走到写着“海天丛林”的墙前。
caption.en: The wall bearing the words 'Haitian Conglin'.

caption.zh: 殿前的屋檐和白色台阶，也留在了蓝天下。
caption.en: Temple eaves and white steps beneath the blue sky.

caption.zh: 回头看，海上观音已经在远处了。
caption.en: Looking back towards Guanyin across the water.

paragraphs.zh: 寺院门前的台阶，把视线一步步引到门楼。
paragraphs.en: The steps in front of the temple led the eye up towards the gateway.

caption.zh: 台阶把视线引向寺院的门楼。
caption.en: Steps leading up towards the temple gateway.

paragraphs.zh: 离开之前，再拍一片树影和草地。几天里反复出现的椰树，到最后也还是舍得多留一张。
paragraphs.en: Before leaving, I took another picture of grass and tree shadows. Coconut palms had appeared again and again over these days, and I still wanted to keep one more view.

caption.zh: 离开之前，再留下一片树影和草地。
caption.en: One more patch of lawn and shade before we left.

paragraphs.zh: 傍晚，镜头从树和海转回城市建筑，旅程开始向返程收拢。
paragraphs.en: By evening, the camera had turned from trees and sea back to city buildings, and the trip began to draw towards the journey home.

caption.zh: 傍晚，镜头从树和海转回了城市建筑。
caption.en: By evening, the pictures had turned from trees and sea to buildings.

paragraphs.zh: 到了凤凰机场，塔台后面已经有了晚霞。这次三亚，就从机舱里三个人的合照，走到了机场最后的一张照片。
paragraphs.en: At Phoenix Airport, sunset colour was already behind the control tower. Our Sanya trip had gone from a picture of the three of us in an aircraft cabin to one last airport photograph.

caption.zh: 机场塔台后面，天色已经开始变暖。
caption.en: Warm evening light behind the airport control tower.

caption.zh: 最后一张机场照片，把这次三亚旅行收进了结尾。
caption.en: One last airport picture to close our Sanya trip.

paragraphs.zh: 这趟来三亚，本来就是想在冬天找一点暖和，陪妈妈和妹妹放松。回头看，确实不必用多少地方来证明一趟旅行：在海边轮流拍照，在浪里牵着手，在泳池里靠到一起，这些就已经够了。
paragraphs.en: The reason for coming to Sanya had been to find a little warmth in winter and relax with Mum and my sister. Looking back, a trip does not need a long list of places to prove its worth: taking turns for pictures by the sea, holding hands in the waves, and leaning together in the pool were enough.

paragraphs.zh: 冬天的日期还写在照片里，画面里却是另一种季节。能和她们一起在那片阳光下面待一会儿，就是这次出门最想留下的东西。
paragraphs.en: The dates still said winter, but the pictures held another season. Spending a little time with them in that sunshine was what I most wanted to keep from this trip.
